lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd8In4Ir4 (reduced formula Nd2InIr) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements adopt eight-coordinate, body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements: each Ir center has eight Nd neighbors, each In center has eight Nd neighbors, and each Nd center has four In plus four Ir neighbors, all at 3.0791 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Nd-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between In- and Ir-centered polyhedra.
